needs_human.note: On a server-rendered page, the first committed frame reports isMobile=false and useIsWideViewport=false together, which is inconsistent: 'desktop' yet 'narrow'. Consumer layout effects run once with this pair.; On a client-side navigation (a non-hydrating mount), useSyncExternalStore uses getSnapshot right away, so the first render has the real width. This matches the old useState initializer.; useFocusLayout is always false in the server render and the hydration commit, so focus mode never appears in the first paint even when stored state and width allow it.

During the hydration commit, every consumer receives isMobile=false and wide=false at the same time; the code does not specify whether layout effects in the consumers (ShellLayout useLayoutEffect, useInspectorFit, MarkdownDocumentLayout split→preview effect) behave correctly in that state.
